title: Imperative Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 📜️imperative plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative) from V1 taxonomy shape to the new Shape V2 tree-purity rule per TEMPLATE.md §14 in ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE. Mechanical only: relocate owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (update [lib] path, add ../../ prefix to #[path] strings), fold 🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs, 🦀️wasm.rs siblings into their own component folders, relocate 📚️examples and AGENTS.md to owner root (already there), verify check/clippy/test, confirm tree purity. The 5 🧩️extensions/* crates (🎮️control, 🫀️core, 🧠️logic, 🧮️math, 📝️text) are explicitly untouched.
summary: Retrofitted 📜️imperative to Shape V2 tree purity. Moved 📦️lib.rs → 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (Cargo.toml [lib] path updated).
